name: write-like-me
description: Audit, rewrite, or generate content to strip AI writing patterns and match the author's voice, plus a bundled scanner that finds and strips invisible AI watermarks (zero-width and bidi Unicode, tag characters, chat-UI fingerprints, frontmatter provenance keys). Modes: detect / rewrite / edit-in-place / generate / marks-only. Voice profiles include a baked-in 'karthik' profile.
